scope.user_request: Electric cars on sale in the United States and Europe, with battery / powertrain / range / consumption details and citations.
scope.us_market_definition: Battery-electric passenger vehicles present in the official FuelEconomy.gov / EPA 2025-2026 downloadable dataset.
scope.europe_market_definition: Current-ish Europe-oriented passenger BEV technical reference built from Open EV Data entries filtered to vehicle_type=car and release_year>=2023, cross-checked against EAFO / BEV Database / EV Database public market references.
scope.important_caveat: A clean public bulk WLTP-per-trim export for Europe was not surfaced. Europe rows therefore keep the source's own range field and explicitly label the cycle as source-listed / unspecified unless the source itself explicitly labeled it.

epa_fueleconomy_vehicles_csv.name: FuelEconomy.gov downloadable vehicle data
epa_fueleconomy_vehicles_csv.notes: EPA/FuelEconomy current and historical downloadable vehicle data used here for 2025-2026 battery-electric vehicles.

edmunds_ev_range_consumption.name: Edmunds Tested: Electric Car Range and Consumption
edmunds_ev_range_consumption.notes: Useful complement to EPA ratings; not used as the primary machine-ingestible source in this package.

eafo_available_models.name: European Alternative Fuels Observatory - Available electric vehicle models
eafo_available_models.notes: Official European Commission-operated source showing currently available EU electric vehicle models and key market fields.

bev_database_europe.name: BEV Database - electric cars in Europe
bev_database_europe.notes: Public EU EV comparison database with efficiency, charging and WLTP-oriented comparison context; public site is not a simple bulk JSON export.

ev_database_europe.name: EV Database
ev_database_europe.notes: Public EU EV database with battery, fast-charge, range and availability metadata; used here as a validation/reference source.

open_ev_data_v1.name: Open EV Data (KilowattApp/open-ev-data)
open_ev_data_v1.notes: Downloaded machine-readable technical dataset with battery, AC/DC charging and energy-consumption fields.
